there is a lack of refactoring techniques for reverse engineered process models.

the state of the art of the field of refactoring business process models is still at its early stages.

the refactoring research community is currently focusing in the development of refactoring techniques for new business processes models, while it is still necessary to develop refactoring techniques for existing business processes models.
